subject: Calgary Core Physiotherapy homepage idea
text:
Hi Calgary Core team,

638 five-star Google reviews, many from patients who had bad luck at other clinics before finding Dylan and Tim. That is rare.

We sketched a homepage idea for Calgary Core: https://sitesbyms.com/calgary-core-physiotherapy/

On the page, one tap gets you a competitive analysis: how you compare with 4-5 physio clinics nearby. No forms.

Best regards,
Mostafa
